ir_definition: IR is computed as the proportion of nmaj to nmin, where nmin is the smallest number of class samples among the minority classes. A data set is considered to be imbalanced if IR>1.5

outcome.smote_name_as_printed: OSMOTE (OVOSMOTE: 'uses SMOTE as an ad hoc approach after OVO decomposition')

chosen.table: Table 6 (10 numeric data sets) + Table 9 (7 nominal/mixed-type data sets)
chosen.condition: main suite, original IR; 5-fold CV x 10 runs (Pre2D/PreND: fixed temporal train/test, 10 runs)

outcome.stat_test: Friedman test with Bonferroni-Dunn post hoc test, AMDO as control, alpha=0.05 (Tables 7, 10, 12); Wilcoxon test for AMDO vs MDO/MDO+ (Table 4)

win_claim.quote: The results confirm that AMDO improves both the accuracy of the minority class and the overall performance of the classifier in most data sets, showing promising precision and AUC.

uncertain: SMOTE choice: no plain SMOTE baseline; picked OSMOTE (OVO+SMOTE) per schema example 'SMOTE+OVO'; SSMOTE (Static-SMOTE, iterative SMOTE) also present, its MAUC stored per row as ssmote_value (Tables 6/9, p.10-11)
Metric: no G-mean reported (metrics Pmin, Pavg, AUCm, MAUC); chose MAUC as AUC-family overall metric; AUCm is minority-class AUC alternative (p.7)
source_repo per dataset not stated; paper only says 15 data sets from UCI and KEEL (p.6)
Pre2D/PreND how_obtained set 'not stated' (authors assembled attributes from CMA data, Sec 4.1.1 p.6)
Dermatology marked modified for removal of samples with missing values (p.6); this is row removal not class choice
n_minority/n_majority left null: multiclass, only class distribution printed (Table 1 p.7)
best_other computed over Base, SSMOTE, GCS, ABNC (excludes OSMOTE and AMDO); ties joined with '/'
Page numbers are PDF page indices; printed page numbers match (1-14)
notes: IEEE TKDE (accepted 2017, DOI 10.1109/TKDE.2017.2761347). Proposed AMDO; precursor MDO and MDO+ compared only on 10 numeric sets with C4.5 (Tables 2-3, p.8-9). Results for SMOTE variants are in Tables 5/6 (numeric) and 8/9 (nominal/mixed) with Pmin, Pavg, AUCm, MAUC; Table 13 (p.12) average minimum sensitivity (Base 52.94, SSMOTE 58.21, OSMOTE 61.28, AMDO 65.18). Only C4.5 used as base classifier. AMDO params K1=5, K2=10 (K1=1 for Balance, Breast-tissue); SSMOTE/OSMOTE k=5. Tables rendered from PDF images at 170 dpi and cross-checked against text extraction. Extra row fields ssmote_value/ssmote_std/source added beyond schema.
